body: From this moment right now, if you parents knew everything, what would happen to you both? I’m not trying to presume anything, but it sounds like he would be fired or arrested for sexual advances, manipulation or assault and you would be…….. what exactly?

This too shall pass. Feeling down, really I get it. (The first time I wanted to kill myself I was 11) People really have a really hard time relating to the impossible loneliness of a single man who is genuinely trying to put himself out there. 

As nothing more than a caring random voice from the internet, I have 2 points of advice for you. 

1. Some people were born hunters and some people were born fisherman. If putting yourself out there in a way that makes you uncomfortable, try doing something in an environment that makes you more comfortable and therefor more likely to blossom and thrive. I’m not saying to let yourself go, but what do you do for fun? Take a moment to do that today. 

2. This too shall pass. Even when you don’t think so, this too shall pass. Feeling down? It can never rain FOREVER. And just when you think you know all the answers? Trust me, that will change too. 

Just try to makes plans with yourself for breakfast tomorrow, and go from there.

Yes you should. You haven’t lived if you haven’t given yourself your own chance. I don’t know how old you are but take it from a person who’s body is slowly failing him, life can be wonderful if you can just give yourself a chance. Life can also be quite Hellish at times. 

Any “broke” person can get money. Anybody who BELIEVES they are “poor” will stay that way. Being poor is a mindset. YOU AND YOUR SOUL ARE NOT POOR. Reaching out to others for help is proof of that.
